subtests.name: Script injected via direct `eval` is allowed with `trusted-types-eval` and `require-trusted-types-for 'script'` (Dedicated Worker).
Scripts injected via direct `eval` are not allowed with `trusted-types-eval` without `require-trusted-types-for 'script'` (DedicatedWorker).
